lineage.transition_reason: blind acquisition-schema repair after pinned llama.cpp reported its padded effective context capacity
lineage.fixture_equivalence: all corpus, tokenizer, model, execution, operation, and token records are exact predecessor copies
lineage.reacquisition: exclude predecessor evidence and reacquire every local and llama.cpp operation from one new clean source commit

acquisition_model_lock.fixture_generation_dependency: none beyond the separately qualified tokenizer artifact
acquisition_model_lock.verification_phase: hash every local shard before local or llama.cpp acquisition

tokenizer.fixture_generation_qualification: exact released tokenizer fingerprint; model weight bytes are not fixture inputs

source.redistribution: derived token IDs, titles, row metadata, and hashes only

token_qualification.selection_order: first token-qualified documents in source row order

support_runs.reason: selector captures are localization evidence acquired only in a separately preregistered packet

bootstrap.draw_order: draw-major, then ascending stratum, then three replacement indices; one shared resample matrix for B-A, C-A, and C-B
bootstrap.bounded_mapping: largest u64 acceptance zone divisible by 3, reject values outside it, accepted_value modulo 3
bootstrap.aggregation: mean of the 12 sampled document mean-NLL deltas; each document contains 96 equally weighted tokens
bootstrap.quantile_convention: nearest-rank upper percentile: sorted_draws[ceil(p * draws) - 1], no interpolation
